title: Zeyna
_note: PRO_03, A1.1, A1.2, A1.6. Lines keep MAIN_QUEST.md IDs where they have one, for voicing. Options show short text; spoken is the fuller line he says. starts: the first whose condition holds opens the conversation.

bundle.speaker: Zeyna
bundle.text: The wife all right? Eating? Sleeping?

choices.spoken: She's well. You ask like a doctor.
Come to supper tomorrow. She'd like it.

doctor.speaker: Zeyna
doctor.text: I ask like a friend who was never thanked.

give.speaker: Zeyna
give.text: [Low, putting a small bundle in his hands.] Give her this. Tell her I said the weather is changing.

choices.spoken: The weather is changing. I will.

waking.speaker: Zeyna
waking.text: You've been asking for water in your sleep. Not for her. Water.

where.speaker: Zeyna
where.text: There was a fire. There was what the fire left. I did what I could, and I did it properly. [A pause.] I'm sorry. I'm not going to say it was quick. I don't know that it was.

tree.speaker: Zeyna
tree.text: Under the pomegranate. It was your wife's favourite tree.

walk.speaker: Zeyna
walk.text: When you can walk, I'll take you.

brand.speaker: Zeyna
brand.text: A fish-hook in a grain of salt. It's his. The Saltmaker's. He leaves it on one person in every place he visits. They call that person the messenger.

message.speaker: Zeyna
message.text: That he doesn't need a reason. Or that he has one, and you're not worth the telling.

choices.text: [Cold] What do you want for it?

choices.spoken: My wife asked about the weather. You knew something.

notYet.speaker: Zeyna
notYet.text: Not yet you don't. Walk first.

price.speaker: Zeyna
price.text: I knew some things. I'll tell you all of them. Not today. When you've done something with your hands that makes it worth telling.

knife.speaker: Zeyna
knife.text: [She puts his old farm knife on the blanket, cleaned.] Yours. Go to the hill when you can stand. I'll meet you at the farm.

hillWait.speaker: Zeyna
hillWait.text: Go on up. I'll be there. I walk slower than you, even now.

graves.speaker: Zeyna
graves.text: [Three cairns under the pomegranate. A small one. A long one with a flat stone, and her name scratched on it. A third, of plain stones, with no name. Zeyna does not explain the third.]

choices.text: [Cold] I'll kill every one of them.
choices.spoken: I'll find every one. I'll do it slowly.
I said I'd stay. I'm staying.

flinch.speaker: Zeyna
flinch.text: [She flinches, very slightly.] Slowly takes time. You don't have much of that.

well.speaker: Zeyna
well.text: The well. She checked the well stone, the night before. I saw her from the road with a lamp. She said it was the latch. It wasn't the latch.

choices.text: [Search] The gull. Tavi made me a gull.

gull.speaker: Zeyna
gull.text: There was nothing on the floor when I came. Nothing small. [She looks at him for a long moment.] Look at the well.

tin.speaker: Zeyna
tin.text: [Very quiet, reading over his shoulder.] She kept it. Of course she kept it.

choices.spoken: T.H. Tarik. B.K. The one with the hammer.

five.speaker: Zeyna
five.text: You know two. There are five more. I'll tell you who they are when you've earned that too. Start with Tarik. He rides the east road. He talks when he's frightened, and he's always frightened.

hegathe.speaker: Zeyna
hegathe.text: Fourth Era, 173. Hegathe under siege. A column of Crown refugees fled the city. They were promised a road. They were sold. A Forebear officer delivered them to the Thalmor for gold and a safe passage, and then had the survivors silenced, so the heroic relief of Hegathe could be told cleanly. The officer's name was Azhar Kerrash.

wife.speaker: Zeyna
wife.text: Your wife was a child in that column. Number nineteen. She lived. An aunt raised her under a Forebear name, and she grew up, and she kept the proof: his ledger of the payments. Signed. He has hunted the last witnesses for twenty years. The salt trade is the pipe that pays every mouth to stay shut.

folios.speaker: Zeyna
folios.text: She split the ledger into three folios and gave them to three people she trusted. I hold one. The key in the tin opens my strongbox.

choices.spoken: She lied to me for twenty years.
She was protecting us. Wasn't she.
My family died for a book.

story.speaker: Zeyna
story.text: Your family died because a man needed a story to stay true. The book is just what proves it isn't. [She unlocks the strongbox with the gull key and puts a leather folio in his hands.] Take it to the court in Sentinel. Let Hammerfell decide what he is.

choices.text: [Flat] I'll take it to the court.
choices.spoken: I'll take it to the court.

choices.text: [Flat] Give me the names. I'll decide later.
choices.spoken: Give me the names. I'll decide later.

a1.speaker: Zeyna
a1.text: Bandages. Potions. Advice, which is free and therefore ignored.

idle.speaker: Zeyna
idle.text: Herbs. A few things that aren't herbs. Don't ask which.

choices.text: Let me see what you have.
